title: Helping Verb Vs Main Verb
theory:
Same Helping Verb with Same Form of Main Verbs
  When a helping verb supports more than one main verb in the same sentence, it is not
 repeated. The form of all the main verbs remains the same to maintain consistency in
 tense, mood and voice.
